label: ChatGPT subscription (Codex OAuth via CLIProxyAPI)
note: Reuses your ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription through a local CLIProxyAPI instance, which exposes an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint. Run the login step once; tokens land in ~/.cli-proxy-api and hot-reload. Anthropic does not support routing Claude Code to non-Claude models through a gateway, and this path relies on a reverse-engineered OAuth flow — it may break without notice.

service.label: CLIProxyAPI
service.loginHint: {bin} --codex-login    # one-time browser authorization of your ChatGPT account
